The '''Thaereian Government''' was the government of the [[Thaereian system]].<ref name="The Air Up Thaere" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Thaereian military]] enacted [[Coup on Thaere Privo|a coup]] and seized control of the government.<ref name="Storm's Depths">{{LivingForce|Inside-out: Storm's Depths}}</ref>
